```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(magrittr)

case_name <- params$case_name
user_name <- params$user_name
dt_csp <- params$dt_csp
fn_csp <- params$fn_csp
fn_af <- params$fn_af
dt_anameth <- params$dt_anameth
fn_anameth <- params$fn_anameth
markers_use <- params$markers_use
data_hnc_list <- params$data_hnc_list
dt_ignore_mk <- params$dt_ignore_mk
hnc_all <- params$hnc_all
message_sr <- params$message_sr
min_size <- params$min_size
max_size <- params$max_size
min_temp <- params$min_temp
max_temp <- params$max_temp
min_rep_ae <- params$min_rep_ae
max_rep_ae <- params$max_rep_ae
min_deg <- params$min_deg
max_iter <- params$max_iter
num_converged <- params$num_converged
max_mle_runs <- params$max_mle_runs
max_diff_like <- params$max_diff_like
theta <- params$theta
dt_ref <- params$dt_ref
fn_ref <- params$fn_ref
dt_lr_calc_record <- params$dt_lr_calc_record
lr_list <- params$lr_list
gt_prob_sum <- params$gt_prob_sum
```

```{r top, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}

# ---- Create the data.table for top ---- #

dt_top <- data.table(A = c("Case Name", "User", "Date", "KongohPlus version"), 
                     B = c(case_name, user_name, format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), as.character(packageVersion("KongohPlus"))))

datatable(
  dt_top,
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = NULL,
  options = list(
    dom = 't', 
    ordering = FALSE, 
    paging = FALSE, 
    searching = FALSE
  )
) %>%
  formatStyle(names(dt_top), lineHeight = "80%")
```

```{r files, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}

# ---- Create the data.table for input files ---- #

if(is.null(fn_csp) || is.na(fn_csp)){
  fn_csp <- ""
}
if(is.null(fn_ref) || is.na(fn_ref)){
  fn_ref <- ""
}
if(is.null(fn_af) || is.na(fn_af)){
  fn_af <- ""
}

dt_file <- data.table(A = c("Crime stain profile", "Reference profile", "Allele frequency"), 
                      B = c(fn_csp, fn_ref, fn_af))

# ---- Display the created data.table ---- #

cat("## Input files\n\n")

datatable(
  dt_file,
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = NULL,
  options = list(
    dom = 't',
    ordering = FALSE, 
    paging = FALSE, 
    searching = FALSE
  )
) %>%
  formatStyle(names(dt_file), lineHeight = "80%")
```

```{r setting, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}

# ---- Create the data.table for settings ---- #

setting_vals <- rep(NA, 11)

if(is.null(fn_anameth) || is.na(fn_anameth)){
  fn_anameth <- ""
}
if(is.null(theta) || is.na(theta)){
  theta <- ""
}
if(is.null(max_iter) || is.na(max_iter)){
  max_iter <- ""
}
if(is.null(num_converged) || is.na(num_converged)){
  num_converged <- ""
}
if(is.null(max_mle_runs) || is.na(max_mle_runs)){
  max_mle_runs <- ""
}
if(is.null(max_diff_like) || is.na(max_diff_like)){
  max_diff_like <- ""
}
if(is.null(min_temp) || is.na(min_temp)){
  min_temp <- ""
}
if(is.null(max_temp) || is.na(max_temp)){
  max_temp <- ""
}
if(is.null(min_deg) || is.na(min_deg)){
  min_deg <- ""
}
if(is.null(min_rep_ae) || is.na(min_rep_ae)){
  min_rep_ae <- ""
}
if(is.null(max_rep_ae) || is.na(max_rep_ae)){
  max_rep_ae <- ""
}

ignored_markers <- dt_ignore_mk$Marker[dt_ignore_mk$Ignore]
n_ignore_mk <- length(ignored_markers)
if(n_ignore_mk == 0){
  ignore_mk <- "None"
}else if(n_ignore_mk == 1){
  ignore_mk <- ignored_markers
}else{
  ignore_mk <- paste0(n_ignore_mk, " loci")
}

dt_setting <- data.table(A = c("Analysis method", 
                               "Theta", 
                               "Maximum number of iterations", 
                               "Minimum number of MLE attempts", 
                               "Maximum number of MLE attempts", 
                               "Reproducibility threshold (log10-likelihood difference)", 
                               "Minimum template amount", 
                               "Maximum template amount", 
                               "Minimum degradation parameter", 
                               "Minimum replicate amplification efficiency", 
                               "Maximum replicate amplification efficiency", 
                               "Ignored markers"), 
                         B = c(fn_anameth, theta, max_iter, num_converged, max_mle_runs, max_diff_like, min_temp, max_temp, min_deg, min_rep_ae, max_rep_ae, ignore_mk))

# ---- Display the created data.table ---- #

cat("## Settings\n\n")

datatable(
  dt_setting,
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = NULL,
  options = list(
    dom = 't', 
    ordering = FALSE, 
    paging = FALSE, 
    searching = FALSE
  )
) %>%
  formatStyle(names(dt_setting), lineHeight = "80%")
```

```{r deconvo_1, echo = FALSE, results ='asis', eval = !is.null(data_hnc_list)}
cat("## Deconvolution\n\n")
dt_log10like <- NULL
dt_param <- NULL
```

```{r deconvo_1_calc, echo = FALSE, results ='asis', eval = !is.null(data_hnc_list) && length(which(hnc_all == 1)) == 1}

index_hnc <- which(hnc_all == 1)

data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[index_hnc]]
dt_log10like <- data_hnc$dt_log10like
dt_param <- data_hnc$dt_param

warning_message <- ""
dt_param_display <- NULL
graph_eph <- NULL
dt_log10like_display <- NULL
error_message <- ""

if(!is.null(dt_log10like) && !is.null(dt_param)){

  # --- Parameters --- #
  
  dt_param_display <- copy(dt_param)
  dt_param_display[, Formatted := ifelse(Parameter == "Template amount", 
                                         sprintf("%.0f", `Estimated value`), 
                                         sprintf("%.4f", `Estimated value`))]
  names(dt_param_display) <- c("Parameter", "Contributor", "Replicate", "DNU", "Estimated value")
  dt_param_display <- dt_param_display[, .(Parameter, Contributor, Replicate, `Estimated value`)]
  dt_param_display$Contributor[is.na(dt_param_display$Contributor)] <- ""
  dt_param_display$Replicate[is.na(dt_param_display$Replicate)] <- ""
  
  # --- Figure --- #
      
  base_size <- dt_anameth$Value[dt_anameth$Subcategory == "Base size"]
  graph_eph <- create_fig_eph(dt_param, min_size, max_size, base_size)
  
  # --- Likelihoods ---- #
      
  dt_log10like_display <- copy(dt_log10like)
  dt_log10like_display[, `Log10 (Likelihood)` := formatC(Log10_Likelihood, format = "f", digits = 4)]
  dt_log10like_display <- dt_log10like_display[, .(Marker, `Log10 (Likelihood)`)]
  
  # --- Warning message ---- #
  
  warning_message <- data_hnc$warning_message
  if(is.null(warning_message)){
    warning_message <- ""
  }
  warning_message <- paste0(warning_message, message_sr)
  if(identical(warning_message, "")){
    warning_message <- "None"
  }else{
    warning_message <- gsub("&nbsp; &nbsp; ", "&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;", warning_message, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  
}else{
  
  # --- Error message ---- #
  
  error_message <- data_hnc$error_message
}

```

```{r lr, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(lr_list)){
  
  cat("\\section*{LR per marker}")
  
  for(i in 1:length(lr_list)){
    cat(sprintf("\\subsection*{Calculation %s}\n", i))
    
    lr_data <- lr_list[[i]]
    dt_hyp <- data.table(Hp = lr_data$hp, Hd = lr_data$hd)
    tb <- kable(dt_hyp, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
    tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
    tb <- column_spec(tb, c(1, 2), width = "7.2cm")
    print(tb)
    
    cat("\n\n")
    
    dt_lr <- lr_data$dt_lr
    tb <- kable(dt_lr, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
    tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
    tb <- column_spec(tb, 1:4, width = "3.6cm")
    print(tb)
    
    if(i != length(lr_list)){
      cat("\\clearpage")
    }
  }
}
```
